crm_customers.label: CRM customer
crm_customers.definition: Sales calls an enterprise customer a customer: an organization with a commercial relationship. One row per organization; prospects are excluded.

billing_accounts.label: Billing account
billing_accounts.definition: Finance calls the billable relationship an account, and sometimes a customer. An enterprise customer can have several billing accounts; an account is not the customer organization.

product_users.label: Product user
product_users.definition: Product calls a person with a login a user, and sometimes a customer. Many users can belong to one enterprise customer; a free user need not be a paying customer.

enterprise.customer.id.label: Enterprise customer identifier
enterprise.customer.id.definition: Master identifier of the enterprise customer organization. CRM customer_id, billing customer_ref, and product customer_ref use this same reviewed identifier domain. This does not make account_id or user_id equivalent.

billing.account.id.label: Billing account identifier
billing.account.id.definition: Identifier of a billing account. Different from the enterprise customer identifier; use customer_ref for the owning customer. No one-to-one customer/account equivalence is implied.

product.user.id.label: Product user identifier
product.user.id.definition: Identifier of an individual product user. Different from the enterprise customer identifier; customer_ref records the organization when known. Never join user_id directly to account_id.
